context: Add a renewal path (e.g. 'todo renew <id>' plus a renew_claim() that re-stamps claimed_at only for the current holder, CAS-guarded on the observed lease exactly as claim_item and sweep_stale are), and have the long-running verbs (start/done/verify) re-stamp the lease as a side effect so an active session stays live without ceremony. Decide explicitly whether takeover should stay silent or require a --force/--steal flag; that decision is part of w2.
description: claimed_at is written exactly once, in claim_item (todo_db.py:1327), and no verb refreshes it: the CLI has no renew/heartbeat subcommand and todo_db exposes no renewal function. Lease liveness is therefore pure elapsed time via _lease_expired (todo_db.py:1130). Past DEFAULT_LEASE_TTL_HOURS both readers treat a still-live claim as free: ready_items (todo_db.py:1660) offers the item to every other actor, and claim_item (todo_db.py:1303, plus the 'claimed_at < cutoff' arm of its UPDATE predicate at :1328) lets a second actor take it. The takeover silently overwrites claimed_by and the original holder is never notified, so two sessions can work one item at once. Reproduced on a scratch DB: agent-A claims, 25h elapse with no renewal available, the item appears in agent-B's ready queue and agent-B's claim succeeds without error. sweep_stale's own comment (todo_db.py:1625-1627) already anticipates 'a renewal the sweeping replica had not seen', so the CAS defense was written for a renewal mechanism that was never built. Note the TTL is not what makes this safe today -- both readers ignore the claim regardless of whether sweep-stale ever runs, so raising the TTL only moves the cliff.

deferrals.reason: renew is implemented in BenchBox's _project/scripts/todo_db.py only. todo_db_standalone_compat.py's COMMANDS frozenset does not list it, and its fallback forwards unrecognized verbs raw to the standalone todo-db CLI, which has no renew - so 'todo renew' fails under the opt-in BENCHBOX_TODO_DB_STANDALONE=1 path. That adapter is outside this item's only_modify scope and the standalone verb has to land in the todo-db package first, so it is a separate change. Default path is unaffected: the adapter is opt-in and off by default.
deferrals.summary: Teach the standalone todo-db CLI and its BenchBox compat adapter the renew verb
